entries.text: Thank you for calling VeloFit. Your call may be recorded for quality assurance. Please hold while I connect you to the next available agent.
Thank you for holding. You've reached VeloFit, my name is Isaac. How can I help you today?
Finally! I've been on hold forever. I need to return a helmet. Now. Don't give me a runaround.
I can certainly look into that for you. To make sure I understand, what specifically is the issue with the helmet? Is it a technical fault or a matter of preference?
What does it matter? I don't want it! The color is completely wrong, it looks nothing like the picture. It's been sitting in the box unopened since I got it. I want my money back.
I understand. I just need to ask a few questions to follow procedure. Can you provide me with the order number?
It's VF8675309. Look, if you're going to tell me it's been too long, I swear I will get your manager on the line. I know my rights, and your policy says 90 days.
No need for that, sir, I'm happy to help you. Let me just pull up that order... Okay, I see you purchased the Trail Helmet, and it was delivered 52 days ago.
And? 52 is less than 90. Are you going to process this or are you wasting my time? I will write a review so bad it'll tank your safety rating.
Not at all, sir. You're absolutely correct. Your purchase is well within our 90-day return period. Your safety and satisfaction are our top priorities. I've just approved the return for you.
Hmph. About time. So what now? You sending me a label?

Yes. I've just sent a pre-paid return shipping label to the email address on file. Just print it out, attach it to the shipping box, and drop it off at any post office. Once we receive the unopened helmet, we will issue a full refund.
Fine. It better be the full amount. No restocking fees or any of that nonsense.
It will be a full refund to your original payment method. Is there anything else I can assist you with today?
No. Just do what you said you'd do.
It's already been processed on my end. Thank you for calling VeloFit and have a good day.
